Edge cross-77 links n-38-6 ('宝钗螃蟹咏讽世居冠') to n-39-3 ('刘姥姥送野味与见贾母') with type 'supports'. Baochai's poem does not provide evidential support for Liu Laolao's visit or budgeting.
